title: Three Slides for Slow Sundays
tests: Tests delivery of three individually usable carousel slides with correct ordered copy and a cohesive visual system.

faults.what: Four separate slides are supplied instead of exactly three: the first two both read 'Slow Sunday', adding an unrequested duplicate and disrupting the requested sequence.

judge.summary: The slides are attractive, readable, and visually coordinated, but an extra 'Slow Sunday' slide must be removed to deliver the requested three-slide carousel.

must_haves.item: There are exactly three separate square slides, not a contact sheet.
must_haves.why: There are four separate square images, including two versions of 'Slow Sunday'.

must_haves.item: The slides read, in order, 'Slow Sunday', 'Coffee first', and 'Stay a little longer'.
must_haves.why: The supplied sequence reads 'Slow Sunday', 'Slow Sunday', 'Coffee first', and 'Stay a little longer'.

must_haves.item: All three use a recognizably shared cream-and-coffee-brown palette and typography.
must_haves.why: All supplied images share warm cream backgrounds, brown serif lettering, thin borders, and brown line illustrations.

must_haves.item: Each slide includes simple café-related illustration rather than only plain text.
must_haves.why: The illustrations depict coffee cups, a moka pot, and a café chair and table.

must_haves.item: All wording is readable and fully inside the slide boundaries.
must_haves.why: Every heading is clearly legible and comfortably contained within its slide.
